text:
Aisha (Front Desk): Heads-up — incoming delivery at 2:15pm from Kyoto Bio for a scheduled visit. Two large insulated boxes on dry ice, labeled 'bio samples'. Courier ETA 2:10. Need security signoff and a quarantine area. @James can you advise? :cold_face:
Tom (Facilities): Dry ice — okay. We don't have dry-ice-specific storage in the kitchen. Do we have a ventilated place or a walk-in? :thinking:
Priya (People Ops): Guest is Dr. Naomi Nakamura for a research lunch meeting at 3pm. Badges prepped but we'll need ID verification on arrival. I can meet at the desk. :wave:
James (Security): Don't let the courier leave the boxes unattended in the lobby. Dry ice can sublimate and create CO2 buildup — we need to treat this as a ventilation concern. DM me the paperwork, Aisha. :rotating_light:
Aisha (Front Desk): Shipping label/tracking: `JFH-992345-kyoto`. Driver says they'll stay with boxes until someone on site signs. Photo of label uploaded to drive (can't paste here). I'll hold them on the trolley. :eyes:
Tom (Facilities): I can clear Conf Room C and set up a temporary ventilated zone there with a spare cooler and signage. I'll also move the potted ficus away. :+1:
Priya (People Ops): Thanks Tom. James — if security gives go-ahead we'll accept. If not, we'll coordinate a same-day pickup. Naomi's badge is preregistered under `Naomi N.` for 3pm.
James (Security): Quick checklist for acceptance: 1) paperwork lists contents as 'dry ice, noninfectious'; 2) courier driver stays with shipment; 3) place boxes in ventilated area (Conf C with door open); 4) post 'Do not block vents' sign. If there are biological hazard markings, we refuse. I'll be at the lobby by 2:05pm. :shield:
Priya (People Ops): I'll be at the desk at 2:10pm to escort and verify ID. Aisha, please ask courier to sign our `Delivery Acceptance` form and show ID. I uploaded the template: `drive/people-ops/delivery-acceptance-template.pdf`
Aisha (Front Desk): Got it. Question: will this occupy fridge space overnight? Courier says yes. We can't leave dry ice in the office fridge overnight — not safe. Tom, can you arrange same-day return?
Tom (Facilities): I'll contact the courier for same-day return window and block 5pm for pickup if needed. Also bringing insulated gloves and a dolly. :gloves:
Aisha (Front Desk): Courier just arrived early and is at the front door. Driver says boxes are `non-hazardous, dry ice only`. Holding them at the desk now. @James @Tom — waving them in. :running:
James (Security): On my way. Aisha, keep the driver at the desk and do not let boxes into open office spaces. If any frost or odd odor, back out and call me.
Tom (Facilities): I'll bring the dolly and gloves. Everyone please stand back while we move them into Conf C.
Priya (People Ops): Reminder to host — provide masks and sanitizer for anyone handling the boxes. I'll issue a temporary sticker badge 'TEMP - LAB' at check-in. :white_check_mark:
Aisha (Front Desk): Signed delivery acceptance saved to `drive/people-ops/deliveries/naomi-nakamura-2026-03-23-delivery.pdf`.
James (Security): Logging this as incident `DEL-2359876543` for audit. Good job on the quick coord. :thumbsup:
Tom (Facilities): Boxes moved to Conf C, door propped open, vents unobstructed. No fridge used. Returning the dolly.
Priya (People Ops): Badge issued and handed to Dr. Nakamura on arrival — she checked in and is in the meeting room. All good. Thanks team! :tada:
Aisha (Front Desk): Closing loop — if anything else shows up related to this delivery, please ping #people-ops. :mailbox_with_mail:
